definition: The central factual claim is supported, or the commitment was fulfilled materially as stated and on time.
The central claim held up, with a limited error, qualification, delay, or scope deviation.
Some material part held up, but missing context, scope, capability, or deadline performance substantially changed the reasonable takeaway.
The claim was presented affirmatively but adequate credible support was not available; the record did not justify a definitive False verdict.
Reliable evidence contradicted the central claim, or a mature measurable commitment was unfulfilled or reversed.
Credible evidence remained insufficient or materially conflicted, or the statement lacked an objective success threshold.
The relevant deadline or explicit condition had not matured by the evaluation date.
